title: Marvel
author: Majrooh Rashid
text:
You are a marvel to me,
a stunning piece of poetry,
written by moving finger
on a sheet of soft golden paper
brought from Lei - Yang ,
by the sailor from Byzantine
who by chance,
anchored himself
to the black obsidian
with his glance on the coastline
of my fantasy.
I feel full import of your essence
that helps me appreciate your grace.
I wonder why the texture
of your plump words,
resists critical scrutiny?
Is it that delicate and fragile
that you apprehend
It will lose its sheen
with a single stroke of an analytic pen?
stanzas: You are a marvel to me,
on a sheet of soft golden paper
with his glance on the coastline
I feel full import of your essence
that helps me appreciate your grace.
Is it that delicate and fragile
with a single stroke of an analytic pen?
